title: Howard Johnson, the 'ultimate instrumentalist'
summary: Gil praises Howard Johnson, who plays tuba, baritone and other instruments and has worked with Mingus and The Band.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: And let's see, there's Howard Johnson who
plays tuba and baritone saxophone. He's the instrumentalist, the ultimate instrumentalist.
Is he quite large? Yes, I remember.
He's tall. He's not really fat, but he's big. He plays the baritone saxophone, bass clarinet, the trumpet, the Flugel horn, the tuba.
He plays the bass. And he plays them all every well, professionally.
All around, all around, very good.
His father was a a tuba player, but you know (
He's a tuba player in the Country, in the world, nobody has mastered it like he has. The technique and everything is fantastic.
What are some of the other bands he's played with?
He's played with Charles Mingus. That's where I heard him. He's played around with
The band Rock Group you know from Woodstock called 'The Band'. Now he played for them.
